title: Java Collections Framework
intro: Java Collections (fresher level) introduces the framework a junior uses every day. This module is an elevation arc: it opens with the collection hierarchy (the interface tree) and generics (the type safety that makes collections usable), then the three interface families — List, Set, Map — and their implementations. The famous comparisons (ArrayList vs LinkedList, HashMap internals, HashSet vs TreeSet) follow at the canon tier, then iteration and the comparison topic.
